explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 520 days before the shortage posting and again 253 days after

sentences.text: FDA posted the dacarbazine shortage on 2021-10-20 and as of 2026-10-21 it has been on the list for 60 months.
An inspection of Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (FEI 1450022) ended 2020-05-18 and was classified OAI, with the classification letter dated 2024-05-22, 520 days before the shortage posting.
A second inspection of the same plant ended 2022-06-30 and was also classified OAI, with the classification letter dated 2024-04-30, 253 days after the shortage posting.
A later inspection ended 2023-08-24 and was classified VAI, 673 days after the shortage posting.
Corvale General holds two NDCs for dacarbazine: one from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (NDC 00143924510) and one from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (NDC 63323012710).
The Fresenius Kabi NDC is manufactured at the inspected plant (FEI 1450022) per the label.
The top-ranked option by rule is to transfer 3 units from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would give Corvale East 6 days on hand while Corvale General retains two weeks.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-cd4b0b.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%dacarbazine%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%dacarbazine%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-604b46.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('0d81315c-7021-4091-b703-ad135390c936', 'b6b97e41-5f15-498c-abfb-d8443ea4d216') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-595cbc.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%dacarbazine%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-d63b6d.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%dacarbazine%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-1c8ce4.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%dacarbazine%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-f61793.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('1450022') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-4b9a25.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('1450022') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-2c52e1.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('1450022') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('thymoorgan pharmazie', 'fresenius kabi')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-52db2b.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('thymoorgan pharmazie', 'fresenius kabi', 'hikma') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%dacarbazine%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-71114d.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('1123748', '1174894') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-5ea7a4.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00143924510', '63323012710')
